framework.BUNDLED_AND_GUARANTEED: Available immediately on fresh install without prior network use
framework.PERSISTED_AFTER_USE: Persisted in Room / SwiftData / Keystore after user action or prior fetch
framework.CACHE_AFTER_USE: Retained in disk/memory HTTP or media cache after prior viewing
framework.OPTIONAL_DOWNLOAD: Explicit offline package downloaded by user (future Stage G1/G2 packages)
framework.NETWORK_REQUIRED: Strictly requires live internet connectivity; degraded calmly when offline
framework.PROVIDER_DEPENDENT: Delegated to OS SDK or external app; availability not guaranteed by O-TRAVELZ
framework.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Not built or deferred to future roadmap waves
